a.quota: Quota represents the number of analysis queries or file checks you can run in a day or week. The Free plan covers basic exploration, while Plus and Pro plans offer higher ceilings to process large and complex business files smoothly.
a.file_types: We support Excel files (.xlsx, .xls), CSV, and JSON. You can upload files and perform queries across sheets immediately.
a.security: Data protection is our highest priority. Your data is encrypted using AES-256 in transit and at rest, guarded by strict Row-Level Security (RLS), and never used for public training.
a.priority_response: Priority Response is a high-speed routing feature in Plus and Pro. Your queries bypass queue lines and run on dedicated compute resources, returning faster and more detailed insights.
a.subscription: Yes, you can upgrade, downgrade, or cancel your subscription at any time via your account settings with zero cancellation fees or lock-ins.
a.charts: Absolutely. When analysis detects numerical trends, it offers to render bar, line, pie, or area charts that you can customize and download directly from the chat page.

pipeline.l1_desc: Stream and ingest raw files via high-grade AES-256 encryption tunnels.

pipeline.l3_desc: Detect database schema structures and map semantic column relations.
pipeline.l4_desc: Classify target business datasets automatically for precise analysis.
pipeline.l5_desc: Gateway allowing users to confirm, edit or override schemas before running queries.
pipeline.l6_desc: Apply logical validation rules and surface results that still require review.
pipeline.l7_desc: Format date ranges, clean missing cells, and normalize tables into standard forms.
pipeline.l8_desc: Calculate metrics and run statistics using deterministic Python analytics tools.
pipeline.l9_desc: Assemble analytical contexts and extract valuable business bullet summaries.
pipeline.l10_desc: Render multi-dimensional charts, graphs, and inline visual aids instantly.
pipeline.l11_desc: Export high-fidelity summary files in standard Excel sheet formats.
pipeline.l12_desc: Learn and recall previous mapping choices to minimize configuration times.

privacy_policy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy_policy.footer_note: This policy describes how MataQorLab handles data in our product. For formal legal advice, consult qualified counsel.

overview.title: 1. Overview
overview.body:
MataQorLab ("MataQor", "we", "us") provides a cloud platform for data analysis, file management, AI-assisted chat, and optional database or API connections. This Privacy Policy explains what personal and business data we collect, why we collect it, how we protect it, and the choices available to you.

By creating an account or using our services, you acknowledge that you have read this policy. If you use the platform on behalf of an organization, you confirm that you are authorized to accept these terms for that organization.

data_we_collect.title: 2. Data We Collect
data_we_collect.body:
Account and profile data: name, email address, password hash, profile image, account identifier, subscription plan, and billing-related metadata.

Usage and technical data: sign-in timestamps, IP address, browser and device information, pages visited within the app, error logs, and token or storage consumption metrics.

Content you provide: files you upload (for example spreadsheets or documents), chat messages and prompts, generated charts or exports, column mappings, and connection settings for linked databases or APIs.

Payment data: subscription status, invoice history, and payment identifiers processed by Stripe. We do not store full credit card numbers on our servers.

how_we_use.title: 3. How We Use Data
how_we_use.body:
We use collected data to create and manage your account, authenticate sessions, deliver core platform features, enforce plan limits, process payments, respond to support requests, improve reliability and security, and comply with applicable law.

We do not sell your personal data. We do not use your uploaded business files or chat content to train general-purpose AI models shared across unrelated customers.

ai_processing.title: 4. AI Processing
ai_processing.body:
When you use AI chat or analysis features, relevant portions of your prompts, file metadata, and query context may be sent to our AI infrastructure providers strictly to generate a response for your session.

AI outputs are probabilistic and may be incomplete or incorrect. You remain responsible for reviewing results before relying on them for business, financial, tax, or legal decisions.

We apply access controls so that your workspace data is isolated to your account unless you explicitly share it.

subprocessors.title: 5. Service Providers
subprocessors.body:
We rely on trusted third parties to operate the platform, including:

• Supabase — authentication, database, and file storage infrastructure.
• Stripe — subscription billing and payment processing.
• Cloud hosting and AI inference providers — to run application services and process AI requests.

These providers process data only as needed to perform services on our behalf and are contractually required to protect it.

retention.title: 6. Retention and Deletion
retention.body:
We retain account data while your subscription or trial is active and for a reasonable period afterward to resolve disputes, meet legal obligations, and maintain backups.

Uploaded files, chat history, and connection credentials may be deleted when you remove them in the product or when your account is closed, subject to backup retention cycles and legal hold requirements.

You may request account deletion or data export by contacting support. We will respond within a reasonable timeframe as required by applicable law.

your_rights.title: 7. Your Rights (PDPA / GDPR-aligned)
your_rights.body:
Depending on your jurisdiction, you may have the right to access, correct, delete, restrict, or port your personal data, and to withdraw consent where processing is consent-based.

To exercise these rights, contact us at support@example.com with your registered email and Account ID shown in Settings. We may verify your identity before fulfilling a request.

If you believe we have not handled your data appropriately, you may lodge a complaint with your local data protection authority.

cookies.title: 8. Cookies and Similar Technologies
cookies.body:
We use essential cookies and local storage to maintain login sessions, protect against abuse, and remember basic preferences such as language.

We do not use non-essential advertising cookies. You can control cookies through your browser settings, but disabling essential cookies may prevent you from signing in.

international.title: 9. International Transfers
international.body: Your data may be processed in countries other than your own, including where our infrastructure or subprocessors operate. When we transfer data across borders, we implement appropriate safeguards such as contractual protections and encryption in transit and at rest.

changes_contact.title: 10. Changes and Contact
changes_contact.body:
We may update this policy to reflect product, legal, or operational changes. Material updates will be posted on this page with a revised date. Continued use after changes constitutes acceptance of the updated policy.

Questions about privacy: support@example.com

terms_of_service.title: Terms of Service
terms_of_service.footer_note: These terms govern use of MataQorLab. Enterprise customers may be subject to separate written agreements.

acceptance.title: 1. Acceptance of Terms
acceptance.body:
By registering, signing in, or otherwise using MataQorLab, you agree to these Terms of Service and our Privacy Policy. If you do not agree, do not use the service.

If you use the platform on behalf of a company or other legal entity, you represent that you have authority to bind that entity to these terms.

ai_disclaimer.title: 2. AI Disclaimer
ai_disclaimer.body:
MataQorLab includes AI-assisted analysis and chat features. AI-generated content may contain errors, omissions, or outdated information.

You are solely responsible for verifying outputs before using them for business, accounting, tax, compliance, or legal decisions. MataQorLab does not provide professional advice and outputs do not constitute a substitute for qualified human review.

accounts.title: 3. Accounts and Security
accounts.body:
You must provide accurate registration information and keep your credentials confidential. You are responsible for all activity under your account.

Notify us promptly at support@example.com if you suspect unauthorized access. We may suspend accounts that appear compromised or used in violation of these terms.

acceptable_use.title: 4. Acceptable Use
acceptable_use.body:
You agree not to misuse the platform. Prohibited conduct includes: uploading malware or unlawful content; attempting to bypass security or rate limits; scraping or reverse engineering the service except as permitted by law; using the service to infringe intellectual property or privacy rights; or interfering with other users or infrastructure.

We may investigate violations and remove content or suspend access without prior notice where necessary to protect the service or comply with law.

billing.title: 5. Subscriptions and Billing
billing.body:
Paid plans are billed in advance through Stripe according to the pricing shown at checkout. Fees are non-refundable except where required by law or explicitly stated in writing.

You authorize recurring charges until you cancel. Cancellation stops future billing but does not automatically refund the current period unless stated otherwise.

We may change prices with reasonable notice. Continued use after a price change constitutes acceptance of the new rate for subsequent billing cycles.

service_limits.title: 6. Plans, Tokens, and Storage
service_limits.body:
Feature access, AI token quotas, file storage limits, and connector availability depend on your selected plan. Usage beyond included limits may be blocked or require an upgrade.

We may modify plan features or limits with notice when changes materially affect your subscription. Free or trial tiers may be discontinued or limited at our discretion.

data_connections.title: 7. Database and API Connections
data_connections.body:
If you connect external databases or APIs, you represent that you have lawful rights to access those systems and the data within them. You are responsible for credentials you store, queries executed, and compliance with third-party terms.

MataQorLab acts as a processor on your instructions. We are not liable for outages, data loss, or policy violations originating from systems you connect.

ownership.title: 8. Data Ownership and License
ownership.body:
You retain ownership of data and files you upload. You grant MataQorLab a limited license to host, process, transmit, and display that data solely to provide and improve the service as described in our Privacy Policy.

MataQorLab retains all rights in the platform, software, branding, and documentation. No ownership interest is transferred to you except as expressly stated.

liability.title: 9. Disclaimers and Limitation of Liability
liability.body:
The service is provided "as is" and "as available" without warranties of uninterrupted operation, accuracy, or fitness for a particular purpose to the fullest extent permitted by law.

To the maximum extent allowed, MataQorLab and its affiliates are not liable for indirect, incidental, special, consequential, or punitive damages, or for loss of profits, data, or goodwill arising from your use of the service.

Our aggregate liability for any claim relating to the service is limited to the fees you paid to us in the twelve (12) months before the event giving rise to the claim, or one hundred US dollars if you use a free plan.

termination.title: 10. Suspension and Termination
termination.body:
You may stop using the service and cancel your subscription at any time through account settings or by contacting support.

We may suspend or terminate access if you breach these terms, fail to pay applicable fees, or if continued provision poses security or legal risk. Upon termination, your right to use the platform ceases, though provisions that by nature should survive will remain in effect.

changes_law.title: 11. Changes and Governing Law
changes_law.body:
We may update these terms by posting a revised version on this page. Material changes will be indicated by an updated effective date. Your continued use after changes constitutes acceptance.

These terms are governed by the laws of Thailand, without regard to conflict-of-law principles, except where mandatory consumer protections in your jurisdiction apply.

Contact: support@example.com
